title: The Bright Vector Revisited
author: Ada Sandoval
blurb: Ulyana Lockridge, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
